description.en: Collects DeepSeek Harness runtime traces and metrics and reports them to Huawei Cloud AgentArts (APM for traces, AOM for metrics) over OTLP gRPC. Configure endpoints and credentials in ~/.dsh/plugins/huaweicloud-agentarts-observation-dsh-plugin/config.json; the installer scripts in the repository's installer/ directory can generate it from your AgentArts console values. Captured message content can be disabled via features.captureMessageContent. Turning this plugin off stops all reporting; DSH sessions and logs are unaffected.
description.zh: 采集 DeepSeek Harness 运行时 trace 与 metric，经 OTLP gRPC 上报华为云 AgentArts（trace 到 APM、metric 到 AOM）。端点与鉴权配置在 ~/.dsh/plugins/huaweicloud-agentarts-observation-dsh-plugin/config.json，可使用仓库 installer/ 目录中的安装脚本从 AgentArts 控制台参数一键生成；可通过 features.captureMessageContent 关闭消息内容采集。关闭本插件即停止上报，不影响 DSH 会话与日志。
